BiblicalUsage: Diblah is a place named only once, in the judgment on Israel, where the land is made more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblah. It stands in Ezekiel as a byword for desolation, a place the exiles would have known by name.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a place named once in judgment is still worth knowing. Diblah is the measure of how far desolation reaches when a nation turns from God, and the warning is for any land that forgets Him.
